# Line coverage floors (percent) for the code that makes decisions, checked by CI's coverage
# job (.github/scripts/coverage.py). Raise a floor when coverage rises; never lower one to let
# a change through. Hardware, FFI and GUI code is reported but has no floor.
#
# Each floor sits about 2 points under what Linux CI measured (40de416, 2026-11-11, in
# brackets), so moving a few lines in a refactor passes and dropping a test does not.
src/service/response.rs 84    # (85.9)
src/service/imbalance.rs 80   # (82.1)
src/service/sag.rs 37         # (38.9) the lowest: worth more tests
src/overclock/curve.rs 96     # (98.2)
src/overclock/load.rs 98      # (100.0)
src/overclock/mod.rs 91       # (93.1)
src/overclock/clkctl.rs 76    # (78.5)
src/config.rs 88              # (90.2)
